mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% in the past month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investments, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3 percentage points in the past month signals a tightening labor market, which increases consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real estate sales (HOUST) by more than 5% in the past two months signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator for overall economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in the past two months signals a weakening supply side of the economy, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) over the past three months signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where RSAFS shows a sustained increase, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in the past month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2 percentage points, it signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increase > 200k in 1 month AND UNRATE decrease > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 70% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.1 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% in the past month, it signals inflationary pressure under tight monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4% AND CPIAUCSL increase > 0.5% in 1 month
regime_hint: inflationary period under tight monetary policy
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) decreases by more than 1% in the past two months and real GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 2% in the past quarter, it signals a weakening supply side and overall economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO decrease > 1% in 2 months AND GDPC1 growth < 2% in 1 quarter
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.
